meta.title: dsh-copilotkit
meta.description: Bundles the official CopilotKit agent skills plus the copilotkit docs MCP server, so agents answer CopilotKit questions from current docs and source and verify wiring before debugging instead of inventing APIs. Adds two skill-catalog entries, one prompt section, and 7 MCP tools; docs queries go to CopilotKit's public endpoint. When the server is unreachable the skills fall back to docs.copilotkit.ai .md pages; disable the copilotkit-docs row to keep only the skills. One-click self-check and repair on this bundle's detail page.
